tweets.text:
Filmed in a beautiful park in South Florida.

The conversation keeps shifting from artificial intelligence to augmented intelligence, and now to superintelligence. From where I stand, there's nothing artificial about any of it. It's real, and it's happening.

I'm not here to change your mind or to be political. I'm here to stay curious, ask questions, and share what I'm learning from my research and from the people I talk to.

• Why the language around AI keeps changing, and why that matters
• How my conversation with Cynthia last week keeps coming back to me
• What links superintelligence, the companies building and backing it, and what's happening with our soil, food, air, and ourselves
• A preview of my next guest, Abhijeet Abole: a civil engineer and co-founder of a system that turns waste and compost into hydrogen energy
Every topic like this comes with debate, and I love that. My place is in the middle of the road: I learn, I ask, and I share. What connects all of it is that we have a choice.

 Leave a question or a comment below. Let's talk about it.
